sample_unit: apheresis-related search keyword queries submitted to each of five chatbots

links.outcome: Readability (FKGL, FKRE) of chatbot responses to common apheresis queries
links.effect: Responses were generally written at a college reading level. GPT-4o had the best readability (FKRE 43.1, FKGL 9.1); Copilot had the poorest. Readability differed significantly among chatbots (p = 0.001).
links.quote: Overall, chatbot responses were generally written at a college reading level.

screen.reason: Evaluates and compares the informational accuracy, reliability (DISCERN/EQIP), and readability of five public LLMs on apheresis queries without testing a deployment intervention or safeguard.
